message: I ordered a full ceramic dinner set for my party, but every single plate arrived smashed to pieces. Please process a complete replacement immediately.
Opened my fragile glassware parcel and this yellow mug was completely shattered inside the bubble wrap with sharp shards everywhere.
The ceramic glass induction cooktop arrived with a cracked surface and exposed heating elements, posing a hazardous electrical fire risk.
My porcelain serving platter arrived split completely in half inside the box, the shipping carton was clearly crushed during transit.
My checked hard-shell suitcase was completely cracked open and mangled on the airport baggage conveyor with personal belongings exposed.
